text:
From Hakata Station to Fukuoka Airport: two subway stops, about 5 minutes, ¥260 ✈️

You don't even leave the building, the Airport Line starts right under the station. Land, ride, and you can be on Hakata's ramen floor by the Shinkansen gates soon after.

Follow Japan by Station for one Japan place a day 🍜

#Hakata #HakataStation #Fukuoka #JapanTravel
